title: More models, and newer ones behind familiar names
summary:
More model choices came with clearer controls, better visibility into Pollen usage, and fewer surprises when apps talk to the API.

Three paid Ideogram 4.0 image models joined the catalog. Kimi and MiniMax now accept up to 30 reference images, while `glm` and clean slugs across several model families select newer versions. Earlier versions remain available by versioned name; callers using clean slugs may notice changes in behavior or pricing.

Playground and Websim now size their frames to their content, retain their auth menus, and avoid repeating the host tab’s title. Theme preferences carry across pollinations.ai apps and can update an open embed without a reload. The SDK gained a bridge for trusted hosts to coordinate API access, login, height, and theme while keeping embedded and standalone sessions separate.

Enter added recent Pollen transactions and a paginated Activity history showing deductions, models, and API keys. Follow-up work made pagination reliable when records share a timestamp and clarified displayed times. Read-only public stats now cover the app directory, weekly rankings, and health data; `/openapi.json` provides a machine-readable API spec.

Gemini gained a fallback route for unsupported requests and configured errors, while Z-Image routing now favors faster backends without sending all traffic to one server. Text requests translate `reasoning_effort` into provider-specific controls across six effort values. Claude keeps its requested thinking budget rather than silently adjusting it when token limits conflict.
